name: era-0-0-45-thinking-translated
description: a retired THINKING_* stream is translated into reasoning rather than dropped as unrecognised
kill: remove the THINKING_* translation; the events then reach enforcement as unrecognised types and are dropped, losing the reasoning entirely

dotnet.intentional: The retired THINKING_* shapes are translated by TypeScript client middleware; the .NET client has no compatibility boundary, so it skips them as unrecognised event types and keeps only the assistant message.
